## Featured projects

### ChestVision AI

An educational research prototype for four-class chest X-ray classification, lung segmentation and explainability. The described stack includes Python, TensorFlow/Keras, DenseNet121, U-Net, FastAPI and Docker. The prototype is not a clinical diagnostic tool.

### Product Return Intelligence

A pre-shipment e-commerce return-risk platform with multi-tenant workspaces and analytics separating predictions from verified outcomes. The described stack includes Python, Scikit-learn, Logistic Regression, FastAPI, React and PostgreSQL. Repository: <https://github.com/Sandesh64753/Return-Risk-Intelligence>.

### ForeverBuy.in

A MERN e-commerce platform with a customer storefront and admin dashboard, using React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Stripe, Cloudinary and Tailwind CSS.
